about.summary: Render R Markdown to Markdown (without using 'knitr'), and Markdown to lightweight HTML or 'LaTeX' documents with the 'commonmark' package (instead of 'Pandoc'). Some missing Markdown features in 'commonmark' are also supported, such as raw HTML or 'LaTeX' blocks, 'LaTeX' math, superscripts, subscripts, footnotes, element attributes, and appendices, but not all 'Pandoc' Markdown features are (or will be) supported. With additional JavaScript and CSS, you can also create HTML slides and articles. This package can be viewed as a trimmed-down version of R Markdown and 'knitr'. It does not aim at rich Markdown features or a large variety of output formats (the primary formats are HTML and 'LaTeX'). Book and website projects of multiple input documents are also supported.

name: r-litedown
raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = "0.10" %}
{% set posix = 'm2-' if win else '' %}

package:
  name: r-litedown
  version: "{{ version|replace("-", "_") }}"

source:
  url:
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/litedown_{{ version }}.tar.gz
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/Archive/litedown/litedown_{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 67bf33b205989ece20c02ee0082d042067a2c47a820f9e4e164e9b2edc4f4fba

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: generic
  rpaths:
    - lib/R/lib/
    - lib/
  missing_dso_whitelist:
    - '*/R.dll'        # [win]
    - '*/Rblas.dll'    # [win]
    - '*/Rlapack.dll'  # [win]

requirements:
  build:
    - {{ posix }}zip               # [win]
    - cross-r-base {{ r_base }}    # [build_platform != target_platform]
  host:
    - r-base
    - r-commonmark >=2.0.0
    - r-xfun >=0.55
  run:
    - r-base
    - r-commonmark >=2.0.0
    - r-xfun >=0.55

test:
  commands:
    - $R -e "library('litedown')"           # [not win]
    - "\"%R%\" -e \"library('litedown')\""  # [win]

about:
  home: https://github.com/yihui/litedown
  license: MIT
  summary: Render R Markdown to Markdown (without using 'knitr'), and Markdown to lightweight HTML or 'LaTeX' documents with the 'commonmark' package (instead of 'Pandoc'). Some missing Markdown features in 'commonmark' are also supported, such as raw HTML or 'LaTeX' blocks, 'LaTeX' math, superscripts, subscripts, 
    footnotes, element attributes, and appendices, but not all 'Pandoc' Markdown features are (or will be) supported. With additional JavaScript and CSS, you can also create HTML slides and articles. This package can be viewed as a trimmed-down version of R Markdown and 'knitr'. It does not aim at rich Markdown 
    features or a large variety of output formats (the primary formats are HTML and 'LaTeX'). Book and website projects of multiple input documents are also supported.
  license_family: MIT
  license_file:
    - '{{ environ["PREFIX"] }}/lib/R/share/licenses/MIT'
    - LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - conda-forge/r
